news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹23.46 (vs ₹18.03 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹23.46 (up from ₹18.03 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹6.91b (up 7.2% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹531.9m (up 31% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 7.7% (up from 6.3% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has remained flat but the company’s share price has increased by 32% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.body: After last week's 19% share price gain to ₹2,324, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 15x. Average forward P/E is 30x in the Machinery industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 138% over the past three years.

news.title: TIIL: Upcoming Board Results Will Confirm Steady Assumptions Behind Undervalued Earnings Power
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Technocraft Industries (India) steady at ₹3,700, while a slightly lower discount rate and marginally adjusted long term revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E assumptions point to a broadly unchanged valuation framework with a modest shift in perceived risk. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for February 11, 2026, to consider and approve the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and period ended December 31, 2025, as required under Regulation 33(3)(a) of the Listing Regulation (company filing).

The small adjustments to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E assumptions reflect a refinement of their existing view rather than a change in the direction of the price target.

news.title: TIIL: Stable Assumptions Will Support Stronger Earnings Momentum Ahead
news.body: Analysts have maintained their INR 3,700 price target on Technocraft Industries, citing essentially unchanged assumptions for discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P E multiple, which together support a steady fair value outlook for the stock. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for November 13, 2025 to consider and approve standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and period ended September 30, 2025, in accordance with Regulation 33(3)(a) of the Listing Regulations (Key Developments).

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹33.80 (vs ₹30.16 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹33.80 (up from ₹30.16 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹7.73b (up 23% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹766.4m (up 11% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 9.9% (down from 11% in 2Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has remained flat but the company’s share price has increased by 43% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
